_comment: Migration decisions that change legacy privileges. Each needs business sign-off before go-live. The generator applies them on top of the parsed Dataverse roles and records each in design.json (rbac_decisions) so the change is visible, not silent.

decisions.finding: No legacy role grants prvCreateclm_Claim, so IntakeScreen/btnSubmit can only succeed for System Administrators in the source environment. The intake screen is clearly designed for handlers.
decisions.decision: Grant ClaimsHandler Create on clm_Claim at User depth (own records), matching the existing handler Read/Write depth.
